title: Golden Hour Den
description: A child has fallen asleep on a squashy red beanbag in a tree house den, a blue picture book closed on their lap and crayon drawings pinned to the plank walls. Low golden sun pours through the big window, with dust drifting in the beam, while outside the garden glows orange and pink and birds cross the evening sky.

title: Top of the Tower
description: High in the city's tallest tower, a dark penthouse looks out through floor-to-ceiling windows. Rain lashes the glass and the wind howls this far up, while far below the city glitters along a river dotted with boats. Inside, one lamp glows warm beside an empty armchair and a glass of whisky: a quiet, lonely seat at the top of the world.
